000589: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_scalar_type(CIrTypeContext* context, CTypeKind kind);
000590: 
000591: // A complex type as canonical IR: a two-field struct holding the real part
000592: // then the imaginary part, both of the underlying real type. The C ABIs
000593: // classify a complex value exactly as they classify that struct on every
000594: // target this compiler emits for, with one documented exception -- System V
000595: // x86-64 returns a `long double _Complex` in ST(0)/ST(1) where the struct
000596: // goes to memory -- so the struct model is the ABI as well as the layout.
000597: // `is_complex` on the IrType is what lets the arithmetic below recognize the
000598: // value again after it has become an ordinary aggregate; it survives
000599: // qualification because c_ir_add_qualified_type copies the record.
000600: //
000601: // The fields are named `__real` and `__imag`. They are reserved spellings, so
000602: // no C member designator can collide with them, and a debugger that renders
000603: // the struct still shows which half is which.
000604: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_complex_type(CIrTypeContext* context, CTypeKind kind)
000605: {
000606:     CTypeKind element_kind = c_type_kind_complex_element(kind);
000607:     IrTypeId element = c_ir_scalar_type(context, element_kind);
000608:     IrType* element_type = ir_type_from_id(&context->program->types, element);
000609:     u64 size = 0;
000610:     u32 alignment = 0;
000611:     if (!element_type || !element_type->layout.resolved || !c_parse_builtin_type_layout(context->target, kind, &size, &alignment))
000612:     {
000613:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
000614:     }
000615:     IrField* fields = arena_allocate(context->program->arena, IrField, 2);
000616:     fields[0] = (IrField){
000617:         .name = S8("__real"),
000618:         .type = element,
000619:         .offset = 0,
000620:     };
000621:     fields[1] = (IrField){
000622:         .name = S8("__imag"),
000623:         .type = element,
000624:         .offset = element_type->layout.size,
000625:     };
000626:     IrTypeId type = ir_program_add_type(context->program, (IrType){
000627:                                                               .name = c_ir_scalar_type_name(kind),
000628:                                                               .fields = fields,
000629:                                                               .element_type = element,
000630:                                                               .return_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
000631:                                                               .unqualified_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
000632:                                                               .layout =
000633:                                                                   {
000634:                                                                       .size = size,
000635:                                                                       .alignment = alignment,
000636:                                                                       .resolved = true,
000637:                                                                   },
000638:                                                               .kind = IR_TYPE_STRUCT,
000639:                                                               .field_count = 2,
000640:                                                               .is_complex = true,
000641:                                                           });
000642:     context->scalar_types[kind] = type;
000643:     return type;
000644: }
000645: 
000646: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_scalar_type(CIrTypeContext* context, CTypeKind kind)
000647: {
000648:     if ((u32)kind >= C_TYPE_COUNT)
000649:     {
000650:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
000651:     }
000652:     IrTypeId existing = context->scalar_types[kind];
000653:     if (existing.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
000654:     {
000655:         return existing;
000656:     }
000657:     if (c_type_kind_is_complex(kind))
000658:     {
000659:         return c_ir_complex_type(context, kind);
000660:     }
000661:     IrTypeKind ir_kind = IR_TYPE_COUNT;
000662:     u32 bit_width = 0;
000663:     bool is_signed = false;
000664:     u32 alignment = 0;
000665:     if (!c_ir_scalar_type_properties(context->target, kind, &ir_kind, &bit_width, &is_signed, &alignment))
000666:     {
000667:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
000668:     }
000669:     // The IR layout of every scalar is the one c_parse_builtin_type_layout
000670:     // folds, `void` included: the two engines answer one question and this is
000671:     // the single table they both read. `void` is one byte aligned one there,
000672:     // which is what makes a `void *` step by bytes -- the pointer arithmetic
000673:     // below scales by the pointee's layout size and the incomplete-type
000674:     // refusal beside it tests that size for zero.
000675:     u64 size = 0;
000676:     u32 storage_alignment = 0;
000677:     if (!c_parse_builtin_type_layout(context->target, kind, &size, &storage_alignment))
000678:     {
000679:         return IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
000680:     }
000681:     alignment = storage_alignment;
000682:     IrTypeId type = ir_program_add_type(context->program, (IrType){
000683:                                                               .name = c_ir_scalar_type_name(kind),
000684:                                                               .element_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
000685:                                                               .return_type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID,
000686:                                                               .layout =
000687:                                                                   {
000688:                                                                       .size = size,
000689:                                                                       .alignment = alignment,
000690:                                                                       .resolved = true,
000691:                                                                   },
000692:                                                               .kind = ir_kind,
